raw_definitions: Definisi : ~ in the sky, ( colloq ) tinggi melangit: you’d be foolish to believe his ~ -in-the-sky promises, bodoh jika kamu mempercayai janji-janjinya yg tinggi melangit. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : n pai: apple ~, pai epal; meat ~, pai daging; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
